tasks.description:
Create comprehensive documentation for the project's core team structure as defined in the requirement specification. The team consists of 4-5 people with clearly defined roles: 1 Product Manager, 1 Technical Lead, 2 Backend/CLI Developers, and 1 Quality Assurance engineer.

This documentation should serve as the foundational reference for team composition and will inform hiring, resource allocation, and project planning decisions. The structure is hierarchical with the Product Manager and Technical Lead serving as key decision-makers.

The documentation must be easily accessible to all stakeholders and should include visual representations (such as the tree structure provided in requirements) as well as rationale for the team size and composition.
tasks.task_notes: This is a foundational task that other role-specific tasks depend on. Should be completed early to establish clear team boundaries and expectations.

requirement_snippets:
### **6.1 Core Team Structure**
```
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
```
constraints: Team must consist of exactly 4-5 people
Each role must have the specified number of team members
success_criteria: Team structure documentation is complete and accessible
Visual hierarchy clearly shows reporting structure
All 5 role types are documented with correct headcount

tasks.task_name: Define Product Manager role and responsibilities
tasks.description:
Create detailed role definition for the Product Manager position, including all responsibilities and MVP deliverables as specified in the requirements.

The Product Manager is responsible for strategic direction, stakeholder coordination, and ensuring business requirements are met. This role bridges the gap between business needs and technical implementation, making it critical for project success.

Responsibilities include: defining and prioritizing the feature roadmap, gathering user requirements and feedback, coordinating between stakeholders and the development team, managing project timeline and milestones, ensuring business requirements are met, and creating user documentation and marketing materials.

MVP deliverables that must be produced by this role include: user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, and go-to-market strategy for the CLI tool.

responsibility_categories: User requirements gathering and feedback collection

tasks.task_notes: This role definition should be completed early as the Product Manager drives many project decisions. Consider creating templates for the MVP deliverables to standardize outputs.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
- Gather user requirements and feedback
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
- Ensure business requirements are met
- User documentation and marketing materials

**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Exactly 1 Product Manager on the team
success_criteria: Role definition document includes all 6 responsibility areas
All 4 MVP deliverables are clearly defined with expected outputs
Role definition is approved and communicated to team

tasks.task_name: Define Technical Lead role and responsibilities
tasks.description:
Create detailed role definition for the Technical Lead position, including all technical responsibilities as specified in the requirements.

The Technical Lead is the primary technical authority on the project, responsible for architectural decisions, code quality, and technical mentorship. This role ensures the technical soundness of the implementation and guides other developers.

Responsibilities include: architecture design and technical decisions, code review and quality standards enforcement, implementation of core modules, integration with Notion API, performance and security oversight, and mentoring other developers.

This role requires deep technical expertise and the ability to balance technical excellence with practical delivery constraints.
tasks.task_notes: This role is critical for technical direction. Should establish coding standards, review processes, and architectural guidelines early. The Notion API integration responsibility suggests this is a Notion-related CLI tool project.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
constraints: Exactly 1 Technical Lead on the team
Must oversee Notion API integration specifically
success_criteria: Role definition document includes all 6 responsibility areas
Technical standards and review processes are documented
Mentorship framework is defined
Architecture design approach is documented

tasks.task_name: Create team onboarding and role assignment process
tasks.description:
Develop a standardized process for onboarding team members and assigning them to the defined roles within the 4-5 person project team structure.

This process should ensure that each new team member understands their role responsibilities, MVP deliverables (where applicable), and how they fit into the overall team structure. The process should include role-specific onboarding materials, introduction to team workflows, and clear success criteria for each role.

The process must account for the specific needs of each role type: Product Manager's strategic focus, Technical Lead's architectural responsibilities, Backend/CLI Developers' implementation work, and QA's quality assurance responsibilities.
tasks.task_notes: This process should be documented and ready before team members are hired or assigned. Consider creating role-specific onboarding documents that reference the role definitions. May need to coordinate with HR or administrative functions for access provisioning.

constraints: Process must accommodate all 5 role types in the team structure
Must ensure proper handoff of responsibilities defined in role definitions
success_criteria: Onboarding process is documented and approved

Process successfully used to onboard at least one team member per role type

tasks.description:
Create a system to track and manage the MVP deliverables specified for the Product Manager role, ensuring visibility and accountability for these critical project outputs.

The Product Manager is responsible for producing four key MVP deliverables: user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, and go-to-market strategy for the CLI tool. A tracking system is needed to monitor progress, ensure completeness, and facilitate review by stakeholders.

This system should integrate with existing project management tools and provide clear status visibility for each deliverable. It should also support the Product Manager in coordinating with the Technical Lead and development team.

tracking_features: Status tracking (not started, in progress, under review, completed)

tasks.task_notes: Consider using existing project management tools (e.g., Notion, since the project involves Notion API integration) rather than building custom solutions. The tracking system should be lightweight but provide clear visibility to all stakeholders.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must track all 4 MVP deliverables specified for Product Manager role
success_criteria: Tracking system is operational and accessible to team
All 4 MVP deliverables are added to tracking system
Product Manager confirms system meets workflow needs
Stakeholders can view deliverable status at any time
dependencies: Define Product Manager role and responsibilities
